locations.location: Zaffiro Coast: Stage 650 (Shiny), Expert Stage: Stage EX19, Event: ''Yveltal Appears''

flavor_texts.text: When this legendary Pokémon’s wings and tail feathers spread wide and glow red, it absorbs the life force of living creatures.
When its life comes to an end, it absorbs the life energy of every living thing and turns into a cocoon once more.
